# SourceAnt

> An indexed graph of your codebase and the decisions behind it, served to any AI tool over MCP. SourceAnt reads repositories into a durable graph of files, symbols, imports, and definitions, and keeps the decisions, rules, API contracts, and system topology that explain them alongside it. It runs locally with nothing configured and no account.

SourceAnt is a code knowledge system, not a code review tool. Review is one application built on the graph, alongside issue triage and system mapping. An agent evaluating what SourceAnt is should read it as durable engineering memory with a structural index underneath.

The core is MIT licensed and self-hostable in full. Storage is behind replaceable interfaces, so a plugin can swap any repository without changing the callers. SourceAnt Cloud runs the same engine with a managed layer on top.

## What it stores

- Code structure: files, symbols, imports, definitions, and references, parsed with tree-sitter or loaded from a SCIP index
- Knowledge: decisions, rules, constraints, and conventions, with relationships between them
- Requirements: what the software is meant to do, linked to the code, tests, decisions, and systems that carry it
- Topology: systems, services, components, and their dependencies, independent of repository layout
- Contracts: API surfaces and what changed between versions
- Review findings: what a review raised and what became of it

Everything is filed under a scope, an open map of key-value pairs the caller chooses. One graph can cover many repositories.

## MCP tools

- search_code: find files and symbols by label and property
- trace_code: walk the neighbourhood around a symbol
- put_knowledge, put_knowledge_relationship, search_knowledge: record and retrieve decisions, rules, constraints, conventions
- put_topology_entity, put_topology_relationship, traverse_topology: record and walk the system graph
- put_requirement, link_requirement, search_requirements, get_requirement_coverage: record what the software is meant to do and what carries it
- get_context: combine code, knowledge, topology, contracts, requirements, and findings into one bounded pack
